analyst.summary: Mahanagar Gas distributes CNG and piped natural gas across Mumbai and nearby areas, and remains a financially strong, nearly debt-free business. However, a recent spike in crude and spot LNG costs has squeezed margins meaningfully (operating margin down from 29% to 18% over two years) and pushed free cash flow sharply lower, even as the company continues to invest in CNG and renewable-asset expansion. We rate it a Hold: a fundamentally sound city-gas utility currently working through an input-cost-driven margin squeeze rather than a demand problem.
